snippet.title: Go! Go! Mister Chickums - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
GO! GO! MISTER CHICKUMS is coming soon to Steam, Nintendo Switch, Xbox One/Series X and PlayStation 5! 

Wishlist now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2436810/Go_Go_Mister_Chickums

___________________________________________________ ___  __     _        _

GO! GO! MISTER CHICKUMS is a frantic, single-screen platformer that blasts you back to the arcade glory days. Battle solo or team up in couch co-op for two players. Are you ready to rule the roost?

___________________________________________________ ___  __     _        _
